name: animated-tooltip
title: Animated Tooltip
description: A label that follows the pointer or appears on hover.

props.name: theme
props.label: Theme
props.description: Colour palette. The Filled style always uses its primary colour; any theme but Default also tints the Outline style's text and border.

props.name: mode
props.label: Mode
props.description: Light or dark version of the palette. Starts dark.

props.name: follow
props.label: Position
props.description: The tooltip trails the cursor, or stays put next to the element.

props.name: side
props.label: Side
props.description: Which side of the element or cursor the tooltip sits on.

props.name: sideOffset
props.label: Side offset
props.description: Gap between the tooltip and what it points at, in Tailwind spacing units.

props.name: changeAnimation
props.label: Change animation
props.description: What happens when you move straight to another element: the text swaps, or the tooltip morphs to the new size.

props.name: duration
props.label: Duration
props.description: How long the change between elements takes, in seconds. Not used by Swap text.

props.name: elastic
props.label: Elastic
props.description: The tooltip moves on a spring that can overshoot.

props.name: bounce
props.label: Bounce
props.description: Springiness of the movement. Does nothing with Elastic off and Change animation set to Swap text.

props.name: stretchOnMove
props.label: Stretch on move
props.description: The tooltip stretches in the direction it moves. Needs Elastic on.

props.name: tiltOnMove
props.label: Tilt on move
props.description: The tooltip leans into the direction it moves. Needs Elastic on.

props.name: stiffness
props.label: Follow speed
props.description: How tightly the tooltip follows the cursor or glides between elements. Higher is snappier.

props.name: appearAnimation
props.label: Appear animation
props.description: How the tooltip appears and disappears.

props.name: closeDelay
props.label: Close delay
props.description: How long the tooltip stays after the pointer leaves, in seconds.
